accounting.basis: Two sets of numbers. MHIL consolidated (Ind AS; FY26 revenue ₹8,373 cr, Screener EBITDA ₹2,243 cr, PAT ₹1,442 cr) and the 'Network' (adds the three PHF societies: FY26 net revenue ₹10,065 cr, operating EBITDA ₹2,638 cr, PAT ₹1,631 cr). The company's KPIs and most broker estimates are on the Network basis; EPS in the accounts (₹14.83) is on the consolidated basis.
accounting.oneOffs: FY23: ₹244 cr deferred-tax gain (voluntary liquidation of subsidiaries). FY25: ₹74 cr YEIDA charge (Jaypee acquisition) as exceptional, ₹18 cr DTL gain. FY26: ~₹142 cr tax gain on the CRL-JHL amalgamation (Q2FY26 tax rate −10%), ₹48 cr exceptional (Labour Code, stamp duty).
accounting.intangibles: Goodwill ₹3,488 cr and other intangibles ₹2,518 cr at Mar-26 (consolidated), largely from the 2020 merger fair valuation and acquisitions: reported ROE (~14%) understates returns on cash invested; the company's own pre-tax ROCE excludes them (21.8% FY26 overall, ~31% for units over 4 years old excl. CWIP).
accounting.leases: Lease liabilities ₹572 cr (consolidated) and ₹589 cr (Network) at Mar-26; EBITDA is post-Ind AS 116. Rent is small for Max (mostly owned or long-term contracted hospitals), so the pre/post Ind AS gap is ~1% of EBITDA value; asset-light built-to-suit hospitals (Mohali, Thane, Dehradun) will add lease debt as they open.
accounting.workingCapital: Network DSO 95 days at Jun-26 (87 at Mar-26) on slow CGHS/PSU collections; consolidated receivables ₹1,049 cr at Mar-26 (₹776 cr a year earlier).
